arxiv-2301-01901.creator: Daoce Wang, Jesus Pulido, Pascal Grosset, Sian Jin, Jiannan Tian
arxiv-2301-01901.description: Abstract Today’s scientific simulations require significant data volume reduction because of the enormous amounts of data produced and the limited I/O bandwidth and storage space. Error-bounded lossy compression has been considered one of the most effective solutions to the above problem. However, little work has been done to improve error-bounded lossy compression for Adaptive Mesh Refinement (AMR) simulation data.

arxiv-2311-06738.creator: Mohammad Partohaghighi, Emmanuel Asante-Asamani, Olaniyi S. Iyiola
arxiv-2311-06738.description: Abstract The Fractional Diffusion Equation (FDE) is a mathematical model that describes anomalous transport phenomena characterized by non-local and long-range dependencies which deviate from the traditional behavior of diffusion. Solving this equation numerically is challenging due to the need to discretize complicated integral operators which increase the computational costs.

pmc-10497579.title: The origin of suspended particulate matter in the Great Barrier Reef
pmc-10497579.creator: Mohammad Bahadori, Chengrong Chen, Stephen Lewis, Juntao Wang, Jupei Shen, Enqing Hou, Mehran Rezaei Rashti, Qiaoyun Huang, Zoe Bainbridge, Tom Stevens
pmc-10497579.description: River run-off has long been regarded as the largest source of organic-rich suspended particulate matter (SPM) in the Great Barrier Reef (GBR), contributing to high turbidity, pollutant exposure and increasing vulnerability of coral reef to climate change. However, the terrestrial versus marine origin of the SPM in the GBR is uncertain.

pmc-12416066.title: Attitudes and perceptions of biomedical journal editors in chief towards the use of artificial intelligence chatbots in the scholarly publishing process: a cross-sectional survey

Ng, Malvika Krishnamurthy, Gursimran Deol, Wid Al-Zahraa Al-Khafaji, Vetrivel Balaji, Magdalene Abebe, Jyot Adhvaryu, Tejas Karrthik, Pranavee Mohanakanthan, Adharva Vellaparambil, Lex M. Bouter, R. pmc-12416066.description: BackgroundArtificial intelligence chatbots (AICs) are designed to mimic human conversations through text or speech, offering both opportunities and challenges in scholarly publishing. While journal policies of AICs are becoming more defined, there is still a limited understanding of how Editors in chief (EiCs) of biomedical journals’ view these tools.

pmc-12613647.title: Methotrexate oral or subcutaneous for rheumatoid arthritis (MOOSE): study protocol for a multi-centre randomised trial
pmc-12613647.creator: Sarah McClure, Rebecca Haydock, Yuanfei Su, Caroline Rick, Steven Blackburn, Michael Brooks, Christopher J. Edwards, Christian Mallen, Karim Raza, Clare Jinks, Matt Stevenson, Alan Montgomery, Trish Hepburn, Abhishek Abhishek
pmc-12613647.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundRheumatoid arthritis is the commonest chronic inflammatory arthritis. Oral methotrexate is recommended as the first-line disease modifying drug for its management, and subcutaneous injections are typically prescribed if there is gastrointestinal intolerance or suboptimal efficacy. It is not known whether subcutaneous methotrexate is more effective and cost-effective compared to oral methotrexate when used as first-line treatment in people diagnosed with rheumatoid arthritis.

pmc-12699906.title: Prevalence and genotypic characterization of human papillomavirus in Iraqi women: a retrospective study of 2,193 cases
pmc-12699906.creator: Mohammed Tahir, Dlnya Mohammed, Chinar Sadiq
pmc-12699906.description: Background and aimHuman papillomavirus (HPV) is a common sexually transmitted infection and is the leading cause of genital warts and cervical cancer. However, research on HPV prevalence within the Iraqi population is limited, with only a few published studies. The aim of this study was to investigate the prevalence and genotype distribution of HPV among Iraqi women.

pmc-13057086.title: Physicochemical and microbial changes in Raw beef meat induced by radiation
pmc-13057086.creator: Ui-Bin Beak, Hack-Youn Kim
pmc-13057086.description: This study aimed to investigate the effects of various electron beam irradiation doses on microbial inactivation and physicochemical properties of raw beef. The main research question was to determine the dose required to effectively eliminate pathogenic microorganisms without substantially compromising meat quality.

pmc-13182700.title: CT-based texture analysis for preoperative prediction of key histopathological features in laryngeal cancer
pmc-13182700.creator: Ahmet Bozer, Fatma Ceren Sarioglu, İlker Burak Arslan, Ulku Kucuk, Yeliz Pekçevik
pmc-13182700.description: PurposeLaryngeal squamous cell carcinoma (LSCC) is a malignancy with significant morbidity and mortality. Accurate preoperative assessment of key histopathological features, including lymph node metastasis (LNM), extranodal extension (ENE), lymphovascular invasion (LVI), perineural invasion (PNI), and thyroid cartilage invasion (TCI), is crucial for optimising treatment strategies.

pmc-13270216.title: When Infection Masquerades as Malignancy: Fatal Basidiobolomycosis Presenting as Suspected Rhabdomyosarcoma in a Child
pmc-13270216.creator: Emmanuella Amoako, Bashiru Babatunde Jimah, Lily Gloria Tagoe, Rebekah Ruth Taylor, Lydia Awuku, Percival Lomotey, Yemah Bockarie, Kofi Ulzen-Appiah, Benjamin Dabo Sarkodie, Loretta Inkoom, Baisakhi Banerjee
pmc-13270216.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundBasidiobolomycosis is an uncommon fungal infection caused by Basidiobolus ranarum, primarily impacting immunocompetent children in tropical areas. Its indolent presentation and radiologic mimicking to soft tissue cancers often result in misdiagnosis and delayed antifungal treatment.Case PresentationWe report the case of a 10‐year‐old child from a remote farming community in Ghana who had a 2‐year history of a progressively increasing abdominal wall mass, severe malnutrition, and respiratory distress. The initial computed tomography scan suggested rhabdomyosarcoma.

pmc-13355030.title: An SSK1-loaded decellularized annulus fibrosus matrix-based PD hydrogel alleviates intervertebral disc degeneration through modulation of NF-κB signaling and ferroptosis
pmc-13355030.creator: Guantong Sun, Qingyu Yao, Xiangchen He, Julong Lu, Jianing Yu, Xianhao Sheng, Derong Xu, Chuanli Zhou
pmc-13355030.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundIntervertebral disc degeneration (IDD) is a major cause of low back pain and is closely associated with inflammatory activation, extracellular matrix (ECM) degradation, cellular senescence, and ferroptosis in nucleus pulposus cells (NPCs). In this study, we aimed to clarify the therapeutic effects and underlying mechanisms of SSK1 and to develop an injectable SSK1-loaded hydrogel for localized and sustained treatment of IDD.MethodsAn interleukin-1β (IL-1β)-induced NPC degeneration model was established to evaluate ECM metabolism, ferroptosis, senescence, and inflammatory signaling.

pmc-13649502.title: Advances in metabolic reprogramming of pulmonary fibrosis
pmc-13649502.creator: Huan Zhou, Tiantian Zhang
pmc-13649502.description: Pulmonary fibrosis (PF) refers to a common pathological change that occurs in a series of lung diseases. It is manifested by fibroblast proliferation and excessive extracellular matrix (ECM) deposition, resulting in destruction of lung structure and deterioration of lung function. PF represents a widespread global health problem, particularly in developing countries, and poses a substantial threat to public health.
